picks.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, its new flagship model

picks.headline: OpenAI announces GPT-5.6, focusing on price-performance
picks.why: A new model in the GPT-5 series is available, positioned as a more efficient option than the frontier version.
picks.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT‑5.6

picks.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 model
picks.why: The new Chinese model was released with immediate day-zero support in the popular vLLM inference server, signaling ecosystem speed.
picks.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3

picks.why: A new, fast, and openly available model adds another strong contender to the open source ecosystem.
picks.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

picks.headline: Chinese threat actor uses AI for autonomous cyberattacks
picks.why: CISA and partners report a state-sponsored actor using LLMs for reconnaissance and exploiting vulnerabilities in real-world attacks.
picks.title: Chinese-Speaking Threat Actor Harnesses AI Models for Autonomous Cyberattacks

picks.headline: Google announces Gemini Robotics ER 2

picks.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration

picks.headline: AI finds real CVEs without frontier models
picks.why: New research shows even smaller, open models can autonomously rediscover historical CVEs, democratizing AI-driven vulnerability research.
picks.title: HoF-Bench: Rediscovering Real AI-Discovered CVEs Without Frontier Models

picks.headline: Bedrock adds prompt caching for new GPT-5.6
picks.why: AWS is offering a key cost and latency optimization feature for OpenAI's new model on its platform.
picks.title: Introducing explicit prompt caching for OpenAI GPT-5.6 models on Amazon Bedrock

papers.headline: Repeated sampling beats complex reasoning at equal token cost
papers.why: Research shows that simple repeated sampling provides better results than complex methods like Self-Refine for the same token budget.
papers.title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B

papers.headline: Classic BM25 retriever beats dense models for RAG at scale
papers.why: A large-scale study finds the simple, sparse BM25 algorithm outperforms modern vector search for retrieval-augmented generation systems.
papers.title: BM25 Wins at Scale: A Scaling Study of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigms

papers.headline: Model compression can create new, unsafe agent behaviors
papers.why: This paper warns that post-training quantization can make models invent dangerous steps during agentic tasks, even while passing safety checks.
papers.title: Fidelity Is Not Safety: Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Data-Free Quality Guard Yet Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution
